characters.look: A lanky, kind-hearted boy of about seventeen with a long neck, gangly arms, a gentle oval face, soft brown eyes, a straight nose, a shy smile and chestnut hair pulled back in a short ponytail. characters.name: Herreper
characters.description: Per i fine klær, med grønn jakke med gullknapper, rød kappe og hatt med fjær. Han sier alltid at han har det finere hjemme, for det har katten sagt at han skal si.
characters.look: Per dressed up as the fine lord Herreper: the same lanky boy of about seventeen with a gentle oval face, soft brown eyes, a shy smile and chestnut hair in a short ponytail, now standing a little taller. He wears a bright green jacket with shiny gold buttons, a flowing scarlet cape fastened with a gold clasp, a broad hat with a long curling white feather, cream breeches and tall brown boots.

characters.name: Katten (den forheksede prinsessen)
characters.description: En klok og hjelpsom katt som planlegger gavene, leder Per trygt frem, og viser seg å være en prinsesse som trenger å bli fri fra en trylleformel.
characters.look: A clever, dignified grey tabby cat, a little bigger than an ordinary house cat, with dark silver-grey stripes, four snow-white paws, a white chest and chin, big green-gold eyes, long white whiskers and a long striped tail that she holds high. Around her neck she wears an old, worn collar of faded red leather with a small tarnished brass buckle. She sits very upright, like a little queen.

characters.name: Katten i hatt og kappe
characters.description: Katten i sin egen lille hatt og kappe. Hun løper foran vogna, deler ut sølvskjeer og vet alltid hva som skal skje.
characters.look: The same clever grey tabby cat with dark silver-grey stripes, four snow-white paws, a white chest, big green-gold eyes and her old faded red leather collar, now dressed up like Per: a tiny scarlet cape fastened at her throat and a little green hat with a curling white feather perched jauntily between her ears. She sits upright and proud, with her striped tail held high.

characters.name: Prinsessen
characters.description: Prinsessen som vokteren tryllet om til katt. Når Per klipper av halsbåndet, blir hun seg selv igjen, med langt, gyllent hår, og hun synger mye finere enn før.
characters.look: A graceful young princess of about eighteen with a small pointed chin, high cheekbones, almond-shaped green-gold eyes like a cat's, a little upturned nose and very long, straight golden hair falling to her knees, with one silver-grey streak at her left temple. She wears a dove-grey silk gown with snow-white cuffs and a white lace collar, soft silver embroidery at the hem, and a thin silver circlet.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: En nysgjerrig og gavmild konge som blir imponert av gavene fra den mystiske Herreper og ønsker å se rikdommen med egne øyne.
characters.look: A short, very fat king of about sixty with a round, shiny bald head, a tiny gold crown perched right on top, bulging cheeks, a red nose, small beady eyes and a huge drooping grey walrus moustache that hides his mouth. He wears a purple velvet robe with a spotted ermine collar stretched tight over his enormous belly, a wide gold belt, white stockings and pointed red shoes, and he usually looks grumpy.

characters.name: Den forheksede vokteren
characters.description: Et stort, loddent troll som vokter slottet om natta og blir til stein når katten lurer ham til å se sola.
characters.look: An enormous, round, woolly troll about four times as tall as a man, covered from head to toe in long, tangled, oatmeal-beige fur like a giant unshorn sheep. Two round yellow eyes glow like lanterns above a huge pink potato nose and a wide, soft mouth with two blunt buck teeth. He has tiny round ears, a long cow's tail with a tuft at the end and huge, flat, hairy bare feet. Silly and lonely rather than scary.

places.name: the Glittering Castle
places.look: A big fairy-tale castle of white stone on a green hill, with many slender towers topped by shining silver roofs that glitter in the sun. In front of it, three tall arched gates stand one behind the other across the road: the first of brass, the second of silver and the third of gold, each with a thick gatepost on either side. Across a meadow opposite the gates rises a low wooded ridge.

places.name: the Golden Hall
places.look: A great hall inside the castle where everything is made of gold: golden walls carved with swirling rosemaling patterns, a long golden table with golden chairs, golden candlesticks, plates and cups, and even golden door handles. Tall arched windows look out towards the three gates, a wide golden fireplace stands at one end, and the floor is polished golden wood.

illustrations.anchor: «En katt kan man ikke låne bort», sa Per.
illustrations.caption: «Men jeg tar henne med likevel», sa Per.
illustrations.alt: I ei tom lita stue løfter Per katten opp i armene. Brødrene hans går mot døra, den ene med ei gryte og den andre med ei takke.

Pale morning light falls through the window.
